raw.description: Hardcoded secret key used for JWT signing.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code can use the hardcoded secret key to forge JWT tokens.

raw.description: Hardcoded database credentials in the source code.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code can use the hardcoded credentials to access the database.

raw.description: No CSRF protection implemented for state-changing requests.
raw.exploit: An attacker can trick a user into making unwanted requests to the server by exploiting the user's authenticated session.

raw.description: Improper access control for project deletion. Only role is checked, not ownership.
raw.exploit: A user with 'admin' role can delete any project, potentially leading to unauthorized data deletion.

raw.description: Exposing user role in the response of /api/projects endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker can learn about user roles by intercepting the API response.

raw.description: Potential SQL Injection risk if query parameters are not properly sanitized.
raw.exploit: If the input is not properly sanitized, an attacker could inject SQL commands.
